title: A Uniform for the Orchard
author: Astrid Okonkwo
blurb: Astrid Almeida, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
